$comment: P127 B4 cross-runtime overloads parity fixture: dispatched and interface overloads, most-derived lookup, receiver-form filters, Color Color, constraint and method-group selection, hiding, and #1385 default frames. Each case calls a static Probe function of `source` on a fresh session; `returns` pins its result. Expected values match .NET 10 except the Default* cases C# refuses (CS0027, CS0120, CS0236), which follow NeoScript's #1385 instance-frame fallback. The web half runs through `neo test` (cli/src/commands/p127-overloads-parity.test.ts); the Unity half runs the same cases over a `neo export`. Vendor this file verbatim.
